crime: A girl saved a chair for {WITCH_NAME} in the dining hall, a quiet invitation to return. But whenever a farewell conversation approached, {WITCH_NAME} escaped it by breaking into a flock and flying away. Today, the girl tucked the chair in.

During afternoon free time in the courtyard, she asked {WITCH_NAME} for one last farewell conversation. Before they could say goodbye, {WITCH_NAME} fatally stabbed her in the chest with a sword. Then she burst into a flock whose birds gripped the sword together and carried it away.

The prisoners later found the girl's stabbed body beneath a tree in the courtyard. They took the flock rising from the scene for startled wild birds. In the second-floor hall, however, a prisoner reviewed a photo on a phone and saw those birds carrying the bloodied sword. Another prisoner remembered seeing the flock return to the dining hall earlier and reassemble into {WITCH_NAME}. The birds they had dismissed as startled wildlife were her escape, taking the weapon with them.
fields.epitaph: By leaving first, she made certain no chair would ever wait for her return.
execution: A birdcage on the execution stand snaps shut around her, binding her to its perch. A flock of metal birds dives through the bars and into her chest, again and again. When her body falls still, the flock settles on it for its final roost.

magic.name: One Body, Many Wings
magic.text: You can transform your entire body into a flock of birds.
